newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Former Russian fuel minister may join Gazprom - Tass.
newsitem.headline: Former Russian fuel minister may join Gazprom - Tass.

text.p: Russia's former Fuel and Energy Minister, Pyotr Rodionov, said he would probably become a deputy chairman of the board of gas monopoly RAO Gazprom, Itar-Tass news agency said on Wednesday.
Rodionov, whose resignation was accepted by President Boris Yeltsin on Tuesday, said he had been offered the post last week, and that he was now ready to accept it.
Prior to becoming minister, Rodionov was director of Lentransgaz gas transport subsidiary of Gazprom.
Rodionov said on Tuesday he was still a candidate to chair the board of national energy utility RAO UES, but that the government may decide otherwise.
